items.title: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Critical Windows Server Bug
items.description: Microsoft initially fixed CVE-2025-59287 in the WSUS update mechanism in the October 2025 Patch Tuesday release, but the company has now issued a second, out-of-band update for the flaw, which is under attack in the wild.
